Panda Hierarchical Intention Evaluation

75 episodes · front/wrist as independent samples · 6,062 frozen observations. The five legacy models share 2,124 completed keys; the completed new 27B hierarchical models are additionally reported on their complete 6,062 rows. Training uses four chronological frames contained inside the labelled atomic action. This evaluation deliberately preserves the earlier benchmark's frozen four-frame expanding-history observations. All models on the strict table share identical episode/time/view image keys, while the hierarchical models receive their deterministic execution context and structured output prompt and the legacy models retain their original prompts. The comparison is therefore a system-level comparison, not an architecture-only ablation.

Interim report

1 of 3 new hierarchical models are complete. This page will be replaced by the full comparison after OM-only and OA + future actions finish.

Important label-provenance warning

These OA/OM references are not human ground truth. They were derived automatically from panda_qwen_segments.jsonl (Qwen coarse segmentation plus visual/gripper refinement), followed by deterministic rules that map each handoff timestamp to an atomic action and mission. The scores below measure agreement with this pseudo-label pipeline and must not be reported as human-annotated accuracy.
